data.name: Tamqrah
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew roots ‘tmq’ (palm of the hand) and ‘qrh’ (to protect). In biblical times, the palm of the hand was a symbol of power and protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tamqrah can be seen as a reflection of the strong commitment and protection that Christians have towards their faith and community. In the ancient Middle Eastern context, a hand was a powerful symbol of divine protection, strength, and support. The use of this name may evoke a sense of solidarity and camaraderie among Christians, emphasizing their ability to protect and defend themselves and their beliefs against obstacles and adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: The Christian name Tamqrah holds a deep spiritual significance that speaks to the unwavering love, care, and protection that God provides to his children. According to the bible, God extends his hand to humankind as a symbol of protection, and His love is all-encompassing, flowing from His outstretched arms on the cross. The name Tamqrah offers a reminder of this divine protection, instilling a sense of peace and security in those who bear this name. It is a constant reminder to keep faith in God's abilities to safeguard and help throughout their lives.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Tamqrah, a minister in Jerusalem, Israel, shares that their name Tamqrah meaning "Divine protection" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
